intents.name: Start a company
intents.description: Assist with a new ANCFZ company, licensing activity, structure, visa allocation and workspace.

requirements.label: How many residence visas are required?

requirements.label: Contact email for an explicitly requested enquiry

requirements.label: Nationality of the shareholder(s)

requirements.label: Is the parent company UAE-based or foreign?

requirements.label: Which category best fits the business?

intents.name: Renew a licence

intents.name: Apply for residence visas
intents.description: Discuss investor, partner, employee or dependant visa support and the required steps.

intents.name: Renew a visa
intents.description: Help existing customers enquire about residency visa or Emirates ID renewal.

intents.name: Review visa allocation
intents.description: Explore visa quotas in relation to packages and workspace.

intents.name: Compare business setup packages
